summary: Improve calendar coordination, meeting follow-up, correspondence and records workflows. Explore this five-day professional skills course.
lede: Administrative training helps assistants, secretaries and executive support staff coordinate schedules, meetings, correspondence and records accurately. Participants practise prioritising changing requests, preparing agendas and action records, organising accessible files using ISO 15489-1:2016 records-management principles, and checking AI-assisted drafts and summaries for accuracy and confidentiality while keeping routine updates and follow-up on track.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who handle administrative coordination, communication, office records or executive support as part of their regular work.
prerequisites: Prior experience in administrative, secretarial or office-support work is expected, including routine calendar, correspondence, meeting or records tasks. No coding or programming is required. Bring familiarity with the word-processing, spreadsheet, presentation, email and digital-calendar tools used in your workplace; use of AI tools remains subject to workplace approval and confidentiality requirements.
